svg.title: S6.3 · The upgrade that broke the stall: the setup
svg.desc: The cast of scenario 27: visitor (asks every 2 s,, prints a result); Service stall (one stable address); Pods stall (2 old Pods serve, 1 new Pod: ErrImagePull). Also: Helm release stall (revision 2: deployed, image.tag=9.9.9). Your mission: Helm says deployed. Why is a Pod stuck?
